variables.meaning: drag coefficient that collects shape and flow effects into one factor
variables.name: cd
variables.quote: For drag, this variable is called the drag coefficient, designated “Cd.”

variables.name: rho
variables.quote: In the equation given above, the density is designated by the letter rho (ρ).

variables.name: v
variables.quote: times half of the velocity V squared times the reference area A.

variables.meaning: reference area used in the drag calculation
variables.name: a
variables.quote: Notice that the area (A) given in the drag equation is given as a reference area.
